chunks: SOURCE: https://www.southernct.edu/career TITLE: Office of Career and Professional Development The Office of Career and Professional Development helps students and alumni with career planning, resume writing, internships, and job placements. The office offers career counseling, LinkedIn review, mock interviews, career fairs, and employer networking events. Handshake is used as the main job and internship platform. Key Programs: - Handshake job search system - Internships and co-op programs - Career coaching and resume services - Employer recruitment events Deadlines: - Career Fair: Scheduled each semester - Resume review: By appointment Office of Career and Professional Development Contact: careerservices@southernct.edu | (203) 392-6536

SOURCE: https://www.southernct.edu/academics/computer-science TITLE: Department of Computer Science The Computer Science Department at SCSU offers academic programs that prepare students for careers in software development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and data science. The department emphasizes hands-on learning, real-world projects, and research opportunities. Students also engage in internships, hackathons, and career development activities. The department supports pathways into graduate school and professional certifications. Key Programs: - B.S. in Computer Science - B.S. in Computer Science – Cybersecurity Concentration - M.S. in Computer Science - 4+1 Accelerated B.S./M.S. Program - Minor in Computer Science Deadlines: - Rolling admissions - 4+1 Graduate Entry: Typically junior year application Computer Science Department Contact: csdept@southernct.edu | (203) 392-7147

SOURCE: https://www.southernct.edu/innovation-hub TITLE: SCSU Innovation Hub The Innovation Hub at SCSU connects students with entrepreneurship, research, and tech innovation opportunities. It provides co-working space, startup mentorship, workshops, and funding support for student-led projects. The hub collaborates with faculty, industry professionals, and community partners to support innovation and career pathways. Key Programs: - Startup Launch Program - Innovation Workshops - Research Collaboration - Student Co-working and Lab Space Deadlines: - Innovation competitions held annually - Program applications vary by semester ihub Contact: innovationhub@southernct.edu | (203) 392-7278

SOURCE: https://www.southernct.edu/ TITLE: Southern Connecticut State University Southern Connecticut State University (SCSU) is a public university in New Haven, Connecticut focused on academic excellence, career development, research, and community engagement. The university offers over 225 undergraduate and graduate programs and highlights affordability and access to education. SCSU supports hands-on learning through internships, labs, research centers, and industry partnerships. The homepage showcases campus news, event announcements, and admissions information. Key Programs: - Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in Business, Education, Health, STEM, and Arts & Sciences - Research programs and grant-funded projects - Honors College and Study Abroad options Deadlines: - Undergraduate admissions open year-round - Financial Aid Priority Deadline: March 15 - Graduate program deadlines vary by department SCSU Contact: admissions@southernct.edu | (203) 392-5656
